subject: Re: Kickoff: LocoProp training-efficiency evaluation
body:
Ximena,

Resourcing:

- Giannis Sato 50% tech lead on the optimizer benchmarks; Emeka Pinto 30% on the training-job integration for the June head-to-head.
- Compute: 16 A100s on titan-a100 best-effort. The whole point is cheap training, so no reservation ask.

Scope addition, agreed with you Wednesday, formalizing here: quality deltas between optimizers on trust models are subtle enough that automated metrics won't settle an adopt/pass call on their own. There's no shared tool for structured human ratings, so we're scoping and building a human-rating annotation UI from scratch — Saoirse owns it at 50% with Giannis contributing the backend — to collect side-by-side preference ratings on models trained with the candidate optimizers. Rating queues, blind A/B presentation, agreement stats. Estimate is 6 engineer-weeks, reusable for the portfolio afterward.

Total ask: 1.3 FTE through mid-July.

Bruno
